description: Connect to your real Chrome browser via CDP, capture its auth cookies, and save them as a Leapfrog profile. This gives you real Google auth, reCAPTCHA trust, and all your logged-in sessions — but in an isolated Leapfrog session, not your real browser. Start Chrome with: chrome --remote-debugging-port=9222

domains.description: Only capture cookies from these domains. Omit for all cookies.

name: profile_import_from_chrome
title: Import Profile from Chrome
